good_thing: (Central Kazakhstan): A male Przewalski’s horse foal was born on August 22 at the Alibi Reintroduction Centre in the Altyn Dala reserve. Kazakhstan’s Forestry and Wildlife Committee says he stood, followed his mother Tessa and nursed soon after birth; both were doing well. He is the first foal born there from horses brought to Kazakhstan through the international reintroduction programme.
current_or_history: On August 31, 1897, Thomas Edison received a patent for an improvement to the kinetographic camera, part of the early path toward motion pictures. A few years earlier, Edison engineer Fred Ott had performed a more everyday landmark for the camera: a sneeze, preserved in the earliest copyrighted motion picture.
tiny_fact: An octopus has three hearts. Two pump blood through the gills to pick up oxygen, while the third sends oxygenated blood around the rest of the body.
thought: You do not have to make today remarkable for it to have been enough.
